objective: AI active-learning prioritization of metabolic-enzyme × direct histone-modifying-enzyme pairs for colorectal oxaliplatin-resistance research
selection: Mean primary validation GI RMSE selects the best eligible GNN for the task; best overall baseline reported separately. No test or calibration outcomes used.

active_learning.model_selection: Choose target_graphless or target_string by primary validation RMSE.
active_learning.labels: Reveal only previously measured training-pool labels; keep fixed validation/calibration/test labels outside query pool
active_learning.diversity: No hard gene-frequency cap during discovery evaluation; diversity is applied only to the medical handoff shortlist
active_learning.ei_estimator: Analytic Gaussian EI from MC-dropout mean and SD, stable log-EI for acquisition ranking; deterministic effect tie-break for zero spread.

uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: dyadic gene cluster weights; report repeated-seed spread separately

candidate_policy.scope: Core metabolic enzyme × direct histone-modifying enzyme only; all other epigenetic partners are separate extensions.

test_use: Public datasets and prior internal results were previously examined. This is a scope and input correction with repeated internal validation, not a new blinded external study.
anchor_identifier_policy: Retain source identifiers for unmapped anchor labels, including TAZ, while leaving gene-function identity unresolved.
partition_policy: Within each protocol all training seeds share the same fixed train/validation/calibration/test records. Seed repetition measures optimization randomness. Primary test/calibration labels stay outside architecture selection across all repetitions.
final_partition_policy: After benchmark evaluation, fit final models on primary train plus primary test (75% HT29), retaining the same primary validation (15%) and calibration (10%). The same primary calibration labels stay outside architecture selection and final fitting.
input_policy: Independent DepMap, TCGA-COAD, CRC single-cell, published HCT116/OxR model flux bounds, HCT116/OxR histone peak summaries and pathway gene features; STRING/Reactome/BioPlex topology. Main GNN does not consume measured source single effects, so all 551 core candidates share the same predictor.
frozen_utc: 2026-10-30; configuration frozen before integrated-input model fitting
